**Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` (`effectiveSummaryFields.map`); `domain:ui`; `priority:p3`.**

The chip has no visible label, so `aria-label={`${fieldName}: ${display}`}` is its **entire accessible name** — and `fieldName` is the raw stored column name. Every other band on the same page resolves a label (`HeaderHighlight` → `fieldLabel(objectName, field.name, field.label)`; `DetailSection` → the section field's `label`). ⇒ one band out of several exposes the database spelling, and it is the band a screen-reader user hears.

⇒ p3 on blast radius, but ⭐ the consistency argument is the strong one: the resolution helper already exists and is used by its siblings on the same page, so this is a divergence from an established in-repo pattern rather than a missing capability.

⚠️ **Hot file — objectui#8728 touches the same render** (the percent chip's text/bar disagreement). ⇒ **serial, ⛔ not folded** — different defects with different acceptance probes.

⚠️ The filing seat notes changing this in objectui#8464 would have moved a pin objectui#8394 owns. ⇒ check that pin before editing; if the fix moves it, coordinate rather than re-baselining it silently.

`Size/model suggestion:` S.

Clause-②: yes

### Why yes

`DetailView` is published, and the chip's **accessible name** changes for input it accepts today — a screen-reader user stops hearing the raw stored column name. Published component, observable output, accepted input. ⚠️ `aria-label` is output, not decoration: it is this chip's *entire* accessible name, since the chip has no visible label.

⭐ Per §0a of the seat post, the dev **HANGS** `needs:contract-review` on both carriers with the draft PR (additively — `POST .../issues/N/labels` adds; a full update **replaces**) and reports the `--pair N` exit code; **this seat clears both on PASS**.

### ⭐ The serial constraint is DISCHARGED

Triage fenced this against objectui#8728 — same `effectiveSummaryFields.map` render, *"serial, ⛔ not folded"*. **objectui#8728 landed minutes ago** as PR objectui#9072 (`2a79e847b`), verified by content. ⇒ the face is free.

⭐ And objectui#9072's dev left this card a clean handoff rather than a collision: their new pin *"asserts only the percentage half of the accessible name, so that card keeps a free hand over the field-name half."* ⚠️ That is a deliberate seam — ⛔ do not treat the existing assertion as a pin that must be preserved verbatim if the field-name half genuinely needs to move; it was written to let it.

### ⚠️ The pin warning, which is the actual risk on this card

The filing seat recorded that changing this in objectui#8464 **would have moved a pin objectui#8394 owns**. ⇒ **check that pin before editing.** If the fix moves it, ⛔ do not silently re-baseline — coordinate, and say so in the PR body. A p3 accessibility fix that quietly re-baselines another card's pin is a worse trade than the fix is worth.

### The consistency argument is the ruling

⭐ Triage's strong reason, and the one to design against: the resolution helper **already exists and is used by this chip's siblings on the same page** — `HeaderHighlight` → `fieldLabel(objectName, field.name, field.label)`, `DetailSection` → the section field's `label`. ⇒ this is a **divergence from an established in-repo pattern**, not a missing capability. ⛔ Do not invent a fourth resolution path; call the one the siblings call.

⚠️ `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` moved **minutes ago** (objectui#9072 extracted `summaryChipPercent.ts` and rewrote the percent branch). Re-derive by symbol on today's `origin/main`; ⛔ cite no line.
